newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy fourth June diesel cargo.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy fourth June diesel cargo.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy gas oil and jet fuel for June 29-30 delivery, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Colombo, a CPC official said on Wednesday.
The tender which seeks 32,000 tonnes (235,000 barrels) of 1.0 percent sulphur gas oil and 8,000 tonnes of jet fuel (65,000 barrels) will close on June 11 and will be valid for two days.

French refiner, Total made the lowest offer for Sri Lanka's tender to buy 220,000 barrels of gas oil and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel at a 10-cents discount to spot Singapore quotes on a c-and-f Colombo basis.
The delivery date for the cargoes were advanced to June 16-17 from June 20-21, the official said.

CPC has raised its middle distillate imports for June due to the unexpected shutdown of its 55,000 barrel-per-day Sapugaskanda refinery after an accident at its single mooring system stopped its crude deliveries.
Sri Lanka normally imports two or three cargoes of middle distillates monthly.
The refinery was shutdown on May 30 and is expected to be closed until June 8 or 9, a company official told Reuters earlier.
